data.name: SettingsSubtitle
data.value: Configure the interface and create a sanitized diagnostics package.

data.name: SettingsDiagnosticsDescription
data.value: Create a ZIP with application and build logs. Personal paths, user names, URLs, tokens, secrets, and product keys are sanitized before the archive is written.

data.name: HelpSubtitle
data.value: How to create a Windows ISO with Windows ISO Builder.

data.name: HelpBuildStep1
data.value: 1. Open Build, choose Windows and architecture, then get the recommended build or select one from Catalog.

data.name: HelpBuildStep2
data.value: 2. Choose the image language, editions, WIM or ESD format, and the output folder.

data.name: HelpBuildStep3
data.value: 3. Run the readiness check and resolve any reported blocking problems.

data.name: HelpBuildStep4
data.value: 4. Click Create ISO. Approve the Windows UAC prompt when elevated operations are required.

data.name: HelpBuildStep5
data.value: 5. Follow the progress in the Build panel. When complete, open the output folder or copy the SHA-256 hash.

data.name: HelpCatalogDescription
data.value: Catalog loads current entries from UUP dump. Preview shows preview builds. Servicing entries are displayed for reference and cannot be used as complete Windows ISO sources.

data.name: HelpTroubleshootingDescription
data.value: Open the build log from the error panel. If more information is needed, open Settings and create a diagnostics package before reporting the problem.

data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: Windows ISO Builder is a desktop interface for selecting Windows builds from UUP dump, checking the local environment, and creating Windows installation ISO images through the existing PowerShell backend.
